peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 8.9% above its local comparables; 86 of 102 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (32.9): 3.9 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 34 of 108 similar developments with a figure (the same as 3). Context, not scored: resales in 83.3% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $1,470,000 ($1,478 psf, 936–1,001 sq ft; 9 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 6 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,295 psf (range $1,211–1,672); 14.1% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $182,000 more. 3-bedroom: median $1,870,000 ($1,466 psf, 1,270–1,367 sq ft; 9 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 6 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,414 psf (range $1,251–1,751); 3.7% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $66,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Simei MRT about 350 m, Upper Changi MRT about 530 m; closer than 69 of 116 similar developments (the same as 2). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 6 within 2 km; nearest Changkat Primary School about 470 m; more than 14 of 116 similar developments (the same as 24). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 2 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 420 m), more than 7 of 116 similar developments (the same as 19); nearest hawker centre Tampines Round Market And Food Centre about 1,390 m; nearest park Sun Plaza Park about 2,240 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Tampines Round Market And Food Centre

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 2 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Sceneca Residence, 3 new sales, about 1,830 m; Pinery Residences, 552 new sales, about 1,930 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 34 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 1,111 new sales and 538 resales (1,649 purchases); new sales were 67.4% of these purchases. Subsales (10) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Bedok Rise GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,930 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 538 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 88 of 116 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 538 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 677 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−20.5%). Planning-area private resales −24.9%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
